Root Cause: Authorization number not submitted with claim
What to Fix: Add correct prior auth number to claim
What to Verify: Confirm auth number exists in Medical Records or Insurance tab
Payer/External System Field: Payer Authorization Portal → Auth Number Lookup

Root Cause: Auth number on claim doesn't match payer records
What to Fix: Correct auth number or request payer to link correct auth
What to Verify: Verify auth number spelling/format matches payer portal exactly

Root Cause: CPT code billed differs from authorized procedure
What to Fix: Request auth amendment or submit appeal with clinical justification
What to Verify: Compare billed CPT vs authorized CPT on payer portal

Root Cause: Service date falls outside authorization effective dates
What to Fix: Request auth date extension or submit appeal for medical necessity
What to Verify: Verify DOS against auth effective from/to dates

Root Cause: Authorization expired before service rendered
What to Fix: Request retro-authorization or appeal with clinical justification
What to Verify: Check auth expiration date vs DOS

Root Cause: Payer has no record of authorization
What to Fix: Submit No Authorization Appeal with proof of auth or medical necessity
What to Verify: Confirm auth exists internally; if not obtain retro-auth

Root Cause: Patient not covered on date of service
What to Fix: Verify correct insurance; bill alternate payer or patient
What to Verify: Run real-time eligibility check for DOS

Root Cause: Patient coverage ended before DOS
What to Fix: Identify new coverage or bill patient as self-pay
What to Verify: Check for COBRA or new insurance; verify termination date

Root Cause: Member ID doesn't match payer records
What to Fix: Correct subscriber ID on claim
What to Verify: Verify ID against insurance card image or payer portal

Root Cause: Group number incorrect or missing
What to Fix: Add or correct group number
What to Verify: Verify group number from insurance card or eligibility response

Root Cause: ICD-10 code invalid or truncated
What to Fix: Correct to valid ICD-10 code with appropriate specificity
What to Verify: Review documentation for accurate diagnosis; check code validity

Root Cause: Diagnosis doesn't support medical necessity for procedure
What to Fix: Add supporting diagnosis or request documentation addendum
What to Verify: Review clinical notes for additional diagnoses supporting procedure

Root Cause: CPT code invalid for date of service
What to Fix: Update to current valid CPT code
What to Verify: Check CPT code effective dates; review for code changes

Root Cause: Required modifier not submitted
What to Fix: Add appropriate modifier based on procedure circumstances
What to Verify: Review op notes for laterality/distinct services/multiple procedures

Root Cause: Modifier not valid for CPT code submitted
What to Fix: Remove or replace with correct modifier
What to Verify: Verify modifier applicability for specific CPT code

Root Cause: Services should be bundled per CCI edits
What to Fix: Remove unbundled code or add appropriate modifier if separately identifiable
What to Verify: Review CCI edits; check if modifier 59/XE/XS/XP/XU applies

Root Cause: Billed units exceed Medically Unlikely Edits
What to Fix: Reduce units or split across multiple DOS with documentation
What to Verify: Verify medical necessity for billed units; review MUE limits

Root Cause: Service not covered per Local/National Coverage Determination
What to Fix: Submit appeal with clinical evidence demonstrating medical necessity
What to Verify: Review LCD/NCD criteria; gather supporting clinical documentation

Root Cause: Claim previously submitted and processed
What to Fix: Verify if duplicate; if not submit corrected claim with ICN reference
What to Verify: Check claim status in PM and on payer portal
Expected Outcome: Duplicate confirmed or corrected claim submitted

Root Cause: Claim submitted after filing deadline
What to Fix: Submit timely filing appeal with proof of timely submission or extenuating circumstances
What to Verify: Verify original submission date; gather clearinghouse transmission reports

Root Cause: Original claim has errors requiring correction
What to Fix: Submit corrected claim (Bill Type 7 for non-MCR/MCD)
What to Verify: Determine payer type; use correct resubmission indicator

Root Cause: Medicare/Medicaid requires new claim vs corrected
What to Fix: Submit as new claim per Medicare/Medicaid rules
What to Verify: Confirm payer is MCR/MCD before resubmission

Root Cause: Provider NPI missing or invalid
What to Fix: Add or correct rendering provider NPI
What to Verify: Verify NPI in NPPES database; ensure enrollment with payer

Root Cause: Provider not credentialed with payer
What to Fix: Initiate credentialing or bill under supervising provider if applicable
What to Verify: Verify provider enrollment status with payer

Root Cause: Patient has other primary insurance
What to Fix: Bill primary payer first; resubmit as secondary with primary EOB
What to Verify: Verify COB order; obtain primary payer EOB

Root Cause: Other insurance information required
What to Fix: Update patient insurance information; resubmit with COB details
What to Verify: Contact patient to verify other coverage; update insurance tab

Root Cause: Payer determined service not medically necessary
What to Fix: Submit peer-to-peer review request or appeal with clinical evidence
What to Verify: Gather clinical documentation supporting medical necessity

Root Cause: Service deemed experimental by payer
What to Fix: Submit appeal with peer-reviewed literature and clinical evidence
What to Verify: Research coverage policies; gather supporting medical literature

Root Cause: Payment less than contracted rate
What to Fix: Submit underpayment dispute with contract reference
What to Verify: Compare payment to fee schedule; calculate expected reimbursement

Root Cause: Service included in payment for another service
What to Fix: Verify bundling is correct; if separate submit with modifier documentation
What to Verify: Review CCI edits and payer bundling policies

Root Cause: Billed amount exceeds payer fee schedule
What to Fix: No action needed if contractual; verify if underpayment
What to Verify: Confirm adjustment aligns with contracted rate

Root Cause: Applied to patient deductible
What to Fix: Transfer balance to patient responsibility
What to Verify: Verify deductible accumulator on payer portal

Root Cause: Patient responsible for coinsurance or copay
What to Fix: Transfer balance to patient responsibility
What to Verify: Verify patient responsibility from EOB

Root Cause: Payer requires medical records for processing
What to Fix: Submit requested medical records
What to Verify: Gather relevant clinical documentation

Root Cause: Documentation doesn't support level of service billed
What to Fix: Request documentation addendum or downcode to supported level
What to Verify: Review documentation against E&M or procedure requirements

Root Cause: Initial denial requires first level appeal
What to Fix: Submit first level appeal with clinical rationale and supporting documents
What to Verify: Gather denial letter and all supporting clinical evidence

Root Cause: First level appeal denied requires escalation
What to Fix: Submit second level appeal with additional evidence or peer-to-peer request
What to Verify: Review first level denial reason; gather additional supporting evidence

Root Cause: Internal appeals exhausted requires external review
What to Fix: Submit to Independent Review Organization (IRO)
What to Verify: Confirm internal appeals exhausted; prepare comprehensive appeal package
